description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio and two metrics: Perplexity and GPU Memory Ratio. The x-axis, labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)", is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100. The y-axis on the left measures Perplexity, ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, while the y-axis on the right measures the GPU Memory Ratio, ranging from 40% to 100%. The plot features three lines: the orange line represents Perplexity, the blue line with circle markers represents the GPU Memory Ratio, and the blue line with diamond markers represents the Full Cache GPU Memory Ratio. The Perplexity line starts at approximately 4.6, decreases to around 4.3 at 40%, then increases to about 4.5 at 60%, and finally rises sharply to 4.7 at 100%. The GPU Memory Ratio line begins at around 50%, dips to just above 40% at 40%, then rises to about 60% at 60%, and continues to increase to 100% at 100%. The Full Cache GPU Memory Ratio line starts at approximately 40%, remains constant until 60%, and then increases to 100% at 100%.
